subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Relacionar o texto, tanto na produção como na leitura/escuta, com suas condições de produção e seu contexto sócio-histórico de circulação (leitor/audiência previstos, objetivos, pontos de vista e perspectivas, papel social do autor, época, gênero do discurso etc.), de forma a ampliar as possibilidades de construção de sentidos e de análise crítica e produzir textos adequados a diferentes situações.

components.description_pt: Identificar as condições de produção de um texto, incluindo público-alvo, papel do autor e objetivos
components.description_en: Identify the conditions of production of a text, including intended audience, author role, and objectives
components.cc_component_description: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting

components.description_pt: Relacionar um texto ao seu contexto sócio-histórico de circulação para expandir possibilidades de construção de sentido
components.description_en: Relate a text to its socio-historical context of circulation to expand meaning-making possibilities
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how the rhetorical choices in a seminal U.S. document reflect its historical context

components.description_pt: Analisar como o gênero discursivo e período histórico moldam as perspectivas expressas em um texto
components.description_en: Analyze how the discourse genre and historical period shape the perspectives expressed in a text
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how genre conventions shape an author's treatment of a shared theme or topic

components.description_pt: Produzir textos apropriados a diferentes situações considerando seus contextos sócio-históricos e discursivos
components.description_en: Produce texts appropriate to different situations by considering their socio-historical and discursive contexts
components.cc_component_description: Produce writing with development appropriate to the task, purpose, and audience

components.description_pt: Avaliar os pontos de vista e perspectivas de um texto à luz de suas condições de produção
components.description_en: Evaluate the points of view and perspectives of a text in light of its conditions of production
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how an author's point of view shapes the content of a text

cc_matches.description: With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.

Analyze seminal U.S. documents of historical and literary significance (e.g., Washington's Farewell Address, the Gettysburg Address, Roosevelt's Four Freedoms speech, King's "Letter from Birmingham Jail"), including how they address related themes and concepts.
Compare and contrast stories in the same genre (e.g., mysteries and adventure stories) on their approaches to similar themes and topics.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
Assess how point of view or purpose shapes the content and style of a text.
